description: The bar chart illustrates model accuracy across a set of experimental conditions related to different layer selections and perturbation settings. The horizontal axis contains the categorical conditions (shown left to right as: “embedding,” “1st layer,” “random layers,” “random layers +B2,” “random layers +L2,” “random layers +R2,” “random layers +permute,” “random,” “random +B2,” “random +L2,” “random +R2,” “random +permute,” and “unperturbed”), with labels rotated diagonally; the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale ranging from 70 to 95 with tick marks at 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, and 95. Each category is represented by a pair of adjacent bars (a lighter shade on the left and a darker shade on the right), with color families indicating groups: blue for “embedding” and “1st layer,” green for the “random layers” variants, red/pink for the “random” variants, and orange for “unperturbed.” Approximate bar heights are: embedding ~80 (light blue) and ~82 (dark blue); 1st layer ~82 (light blue) and ~82 (dark blue); random layers ~79.5 (light green) and ~82 (dark green); random layers +B2 ~79.5 (light green) and ~81.5 (dark green); random layers +L2 ~79.5 (light green) and ~81.7 (dark green); random layers +R2 ~79.5 (light green) and ~81.7 (dark green); random layers +permute ~79.3 (light green) and ~81.4 (dark green); random ~71.8 (light pink) and ~73.6 (dark red); random +B2 ~72.1 (light pink) and ~73.6 (dark red); random +L2 ~71.9 (light pink) and ~73.4 (dark red); random +R2 ~71.6 (light pink) and ~73.5 (dark red); random +permute ~71.7 (light pink) and ~73.2 (dark red); unperturbed ~90.3 (light orange) and ~91.8 (dark orange). The bars are not presented in a numeric sorted order but are grouped by condition type, and there are no visible annotations, outlines, or other emphasis beyond the consistent paired-bar coloring.
